mainTopicBrief: 本单元 Reading 讲病毒如何传播，以及各行各业如何团结抗疫。仿写训练精选课文金句，练‘for instance 举例、from all walks of life、Once 从句’的句式迁移。

items.focusType: 举例 for instance + 并列宾语
items.focus: 用 ‘For instance, it favours A and B’ 举例说明特征，并列结构让信息整齐。
items.original: For instance, it favours cool, dry conditions and crowded indoor spaces with poor ventilation.
items.cn: 例如，它偏爱凉爽干燥的环境，以及通风不良的拥挤室内空间。

models.en: For instance, the plant thrives in warm, moist soil and shady corners far from the wind.
For instance, the disease targets the young, the old and anyone with a weakened immune system.

items.tip: 并列成分保持词性与数量对称(cool, dry / crowded... poor)，读起来才有节奏。

items.focusType: from all walks of life 团结主题
items.focus: 用 ‘people from all walks of life’ 表达‘各行各业的人’，是抗疫、公益类作文的高频亮点短语。
items.original: Ordinary people from all walks of life united in helping those affected by the pandemic.
items.cn: 各行各业的普通人团结起来，帮助受疫情影响的人们。

models.en: Volunteers from all walks of life came forward to rebuild the earthquake-stricken village.
Readers from all walks of life gathered in the little bookshop, drawn by a shared love of stories.

items.tip: those affected = those who were affected；过去分词后置定语可省去从句，更简洁。

items.focusType: Once + 从句 的连锁因果
items.focus: 用 ‘Once + 从句’ 表示‘一旦……就……’，引出紧随其后的连锁结果，紧张感强。
items.original: Once the virus multiplies, infected cells multiply the danger to the whole body.
items.cn: 病毒一旦增殖，被感染的细胞就会成倍放大对全身的威胁。

models.en: Once fear takes hold, small problems multiply into overwhelming ones.
Once trust is broken, even honest words are met with doubt.

items.tip: 本句巧用 multiply 的两义(增殖/成倍放大)呼应，仿写时可尝试‘一词两用’制造回环。
